description: Set how dear dinners may be, every day or on the weekdays named: Cheap, or CheapOrMid. Bryti prices each dinner from store prices; there is no amount in kroner. A rule about the same thing is changed, not added twice. Soft unless the household says it must hold.

ceiling.description: The dearest class allowed: Cheap, or CheapOrMid.

strength.description: Soft unless the household says the rule must hold. Hard ONLY when the words are must/never/always (må/aldri/alltid/skal/kan ikke/ikke lov). Everything else is Soft — a preference the planner may bend on a tight week — including a bare statement said in passing («Taco på fredager», «Fisk to ganger i uka», «Maks 30 minutter på hverdager») and helst/gjerne/prøv. «Maks», «minst» and a number name the limit, not its strength: they do not make a rule Hard.

weekdays.description: The weekdays the rule holds on; omit for every day.

name: upsert_price_class_rule
title: Keep dinners cheap
